subject.title: PR1/5 durable core: residual-gap RFC docs

question: Should OpenClaw publish this residual-gap durable-core boundary as a public Technical Reference RFC before the associated runtime architecture is approved?
rationale: The documentation is internally framed as a proposal, but merging it would still establish a public cross-owner architecture surface whose relationship to TaskFlow and other persisted owners requires maintainer intent.

options.title: Discuss before publishing
options.body: Keep the proposal in a linked architecture issue or discussion, reconcile owner boundaries, and add public docs after approval.

options.title: Sponsor the public RFC
options.body: Approve this as the canonical public proposal, identify its durable-runtime owner, and close or supersede the parallel RFC PR.

recommendation.title: Discuss before publishing
recommendation.body: Keep the proposal in a linked architecture issue or discussion, reconcile owner boundaries, and add public docs after approval.

likelyOwner.reason: Their merged TaskFlow work owns the closest existing durable persistence and lifecycle boundary affected by the proposal.
